reader.requirement: At 85 the files on a called program's internal file connectors are not open whenever the program is in its initial state (first call, after CANCEL of it or a container, every call of an initial program); on every other entry each such file's open mode, status and position (sequential, relative and indexed, any access mode, including a failed OPEN or an AT END) are as when the program last exited.

edition-consulted.switches: stamps the connector's Edition, which FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect and CLOSE WITH LOCK read (DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility, CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector); neither decides whether a connector stays open or positioned across a CALL

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: retention and the CANCEL/initial-program implicit CLOSE are one path; the I-O status values seen (35, 46, 47, 10) are 1985 codes
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f02_05 and 1985-GR-X_5_2_4-7 cover a sequential file left open across calls and reopened after CANCEL; not covered: relative and indexed files, dynamic access and START positioning, a failed OPEN or an AT END carried to the next entry, an initial program's files

probes.printed: OPEN NF 35 / IX K2D2 00 / RL R1 00 / NF 47 / IX K3D3 00 / RL R2 00 / NF 47 / RL3 10 / RL4 46 / IXR K1D1 00 / IX5 K2D2 00 / REOPEN IX 00 / REOPEN RL 00 / FI OPEN 00 / FI R1 00 / FI OPEN 00 / FI R1 00 (run gr7a-002, MATCH)
probes.expected: the START position of an indexed dynamic file and the relative sequential position survive each exit; the failed OPEN leaves the file not open on later entries (47); an AT END carries over (46); after CANCEL both files OPEN with 00; the initial program FI opens with 00 on each call

probes.printed: MAIN F MF01 00 ... IW OPEN F 00 ... IW OPEN F 00 ... MAIN F MF02 00
probes.expected: an initial callee's internal file F is closed at its exit and opens again with 00, while the caller's own internal F of the same file-name keeps its position

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.5.2.4 GR7  (cite.py --check with "the states and positioning of all such files is the same as when the called program was last exited")
OK  §1985:X.2.4.1 GR2  (cite.py --check with "Files with internal file connectors associated with the program are not in the open mode")
OK  §1985:X.5.3.4 GR10  (cite.py --check with "an implicit CLOSE statement without any optional phrases is executed for each file in the open mode that is associated with an internal file connector")

reader.notes: Both witnesses MATCH at 85. Internal connectors live in the run-unit registry under per-program keys and are untouched by CALL and EXIT PROGRAM; CancelNode and EndInitialActivation run the emitted CloseFiles, so the next initial-state entry finds the files closed.

refuter.evidence: g67: a LINAGE 5 file opened by non-initial LP keeps its LINAGE-COUNTER across calls (3, 5, then 1 on the new page, status 00); KP's file CLOSEd WITH LOCK gives 38 on reopen at the next entry and after CANCEL KP (lock is a run-unit property per §1985 CLOSE 'cannot be opened again during this execution of this run unit'), the file is not in open mode (READ 47, CLOSE 42); NF's file in a program contained in an INITIAL program is closed at each new activation (OPEN 00). cite.py: OK §1985:X.5.2.4 GR7 the text is in GR7.
